blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines – Nine award-winning bars from across Asia will come together at NUSTAR Resort Cebu on November 15, 2026, for Asia Icons: The Fiesta Closing Party, the grand finale of The Philippine Cocktail Fiesta 2026. Taking place at the Grand Ballroom, NUSTAR Resort Cebu, the one-night-only event will bring together some of Asia’s globally acclaimed bars and bartenders. The closing party marks the culmination of The Philippine Cocktail Fiesta 2026, which will be held in Cebu for the first time, marking the festival’s expansion beyond Metro Manila.
